technical_notes: Primary workload: IDE copilot integrated as an LSP extension; interactive completions must be low-latency (<50ms tail) for local dev mode; background jobs: nightly + incremental embedding refresh for monorepo (~40M tokens), daily index rebuilds for search.

POC targets: sustained 1k qps embedding refresh pipeline (batching + async worker pool), 200 concurrent streaming completion sessions, 99th percentile tail latency <120ms for streaming tokens, <50ms for final token in short completion path.

Model strategy: pin stable code-gen model version for completions (customer wants explicit versioning + rollout windows), fallback to quantized variant under capacity pressure; evaluate 8-bit quantized vs fp16 for cost/latency tradeoffs.
Caching: plan to use local prefix/KV cache for routing IDE sessions to warm contexts; embedding pipeline to maintain sticky per-repo caches to avoid full recompute.
Indexing: prefer incremental pipelines that upsert vectors into managed vector DB (customer evaluating Pinecone vs Weaviate); big concern: write throughput and upsert latency during large refreshes.
Operations ask: expose token-level cost breakdown, route-by-policy (latency vs cost) for dev vs prod users, tracing hooks for debug in Console.
Security: must support SSO/SAML + audit logging and KMS integration for customer-managed keys; legal requires data residency controls for EU customers served from NA HQ.
